policies.name: National Solid Waste Policy (Law 12.305/2010)
policies.summary: Establishes shared producer responsibility, reverse-logistics for packaging, and a target to end open dumping.

newsFeed.headline: Amazon tributaries carry plastic deep into the rainforest, study finds
newsFeed.summary: Researchers tracked plastic debris hundreds of kilometres up Amazon tributaries, much of it traceable to upstream cities.

wooby.headline: Brazil recycles only a tiny fraction — but recyclers do amazing work.
wooby.narrative: Wooby has dolphin friends in Brazil who say the Amazon is full of plastic from cities far away. Brazil has hundreds of thousands of catadores — recyclers who collect plastic on the streets. They are heroes for the rivers and for Wooby.
